caption: The drawing depicts a single, large, cylindrical ceramic pot with a wide opening at the top. The pot has a warm brown color throughout, with subtle variations in shading that suggest curvature and light reflection. It features two small, rounded handles positioned symmetrically on opposite sides near the top of the vessel. On the front, there is a blue painted or glazed motif, appearing as brushy, abstract strokes. The interior of the pot is visible and is shaded in darker brown and black hues to suggest depth. The background is plain and beige, with no additional objects or scenery present. The overall composition centers the pot on the page, and there is a faint signature in the lower right corner.
